notes.title: Minor updates for May 25.
notes.content:
Update Details:

Some sound effects (SE) have been made compatible with spatial audio.

A few objects have been added to the stage.

The credits have been adjusted accordingly.

notes.title: It will be released on Friday, May 30th!
notes.content:
I'm thrilled to announce that the release date for Mountain's Secret, the sequel to Mountain's Memory, has been finalized!

Mark your calendars for Friday, May 30th—it's going to be an exciting day!
Stay tuned!

notes.title: A Sequel is Coming!
notes.content:
Thank you, everyone, for playing Mountain's Memory.

Mountain's Secret is scheduled for release at the end of May, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Minor updates for May 9.
notes.content: I have updated the text that appears after clearing the game.

notes.title: I have fixed the issue that was preventing this game from being playable.
notes.content:
This morning, we were contacted by Steam Support, who informed us about the issue and shared the solution. As a result, Mountain's Memory is now playable.

Please try downloading it again.
